de.guide_how_to_play_controls:
━━━ CONTROLS ━━━

• Left/Right Arrow: Move piece left/right

• Up Arrow / X: Rotate clockwise

• Z: Rotate counter-clockwise

• Down Arrow: Soft drop

• Space: Hard drop (instant)

• C: Hold piece

• P / ESC: Pause

• R: Restart
de.guide_how_to_play_intro:
Quadrix is a game where you arrange falling pieces (Tetrominoes) to form complete horizontal lines.

When a complete line is formed, it clears and you score points.

Pieces reaching the top of the board end the game.
de.guide_how_to_play_levels:
━━━ LEVEL SYSTEM ━━━

Level increases every 10 lines cleared.

As level increases:

• Pieces fall faster

• Points earned multiply

• Difficulty rises
de.guide_how_to_play_scoring:
━━━ SCORING SYSTEM ━━━

• 1 Line: 100 × Level points

• 2 Lines (Double): 300 × Level points

• 3 Lines (Triple): 500 × Level points

• 4 Lines (Quadrix): 800 × Level points

• Combo Bonus: Extra points for consecutive clears

• Hard Drop: 2 points per row the piece falls

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Example: Piece falls 5 rows = 10 points

Tip: Use Space for fast play!
de.guide_how_to_play_tips:
━━━ IMPORTANT TIPS ━━━

• Ghost piece shows where the piece will land

• Use Hold system strategically

• Keep checking the next pieces

• Leave one edge open for Quadrix (4-line clear)

es.guide_how_to_play_controls:
━━━ CONTROLS ━━━

• Left/Right Arrow: Move piece left/right

• Up Arrow / X: Rotate clockwise

• Z: Rotate counter-clockwise

• Down Arrow: Soft drop

• Space: Hard drop (instant)

• C: Hold piece

• P / ESC: Pause

• R: Restart
es.guide_how_to_play_intro:
Quadrix is a game where you arrange falling pieces (Tetrominoes) to form complete horizontal lines.

When a complete line is formed, it clears and you score points.

Pieces reaching the top of the board end the game.
es.guide_how_to_play_levels:
━━━ LEVEL SYSTEM ━━━

Level increases every 10 lines cleared.

As level increases:

• Pieces fall faster

• Points earned multiply

• Difficulty rises
es.guide_how_to_play_scoring:
━━━ SCORING SYSTEM ━━━

• 1 Line: 100 × Level points

• 2 Lines (Double): 300 × Level points

• 3 Lines (Triple): 500 × Level points

• 4 Lines (Quadrix): 800 × Level points

• Combo Bonus: Extra points for consecutive clears

• Hard Drop: 2 points per row the piece falls

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Example: Piece falls 5 rows = 10 points

Tip: Use Space for fast play!
es.guide_how_to_play_tips:
━━━ IMPORTANT TIPS ━━━

• Ghost piece shows where the piece will land

• Use Hold system strategically

• Keep checking the next pieces

• Leave one edge open for Quadrix (4-line clear)

ru.guide_how_to_play_controls:
━━━ CONTROLS ━━━

• Left/Right Arrow: Move piece left/right

• Up Arrow / X: Rotate clockwise

• Z: Rotate counter-clockwise

• Down Arrow: Soft drop

• Space: Hard drop (instant)

• C: Hold piece

• P / ESC: Pause

• R: Restart
ru.guide_how_to_play_intro:
Quadrix is a game where you arrange falling pieces (Tetrominoes) to form complete horizontal lines.

When a complete line is formed, it clears and you score points.

Pieces reaching the top of the board end the game.
ru.guide_how_to_play_levels:
━━━ LEVEL SYSTEM ━━━

Level increases every 10 lines cleared.

As level increases:

• Pieces fall faster

• Points earned multiply

• Difficulty rises
ru.guide_how_to_play_scoring:
━━━ SCORING SYSTEM ━━━

• 1 Line: 100 × Level points

• 2 Lines (Double): 300 × Level points

• 3 Lines (Triple): 500 × Level points

• 4 Lines (Quadrix): 800 × Level points

• Combo Bonus: Extra points for consecutive clears

• Hard Drop: 2 points per row the piece falls

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Example: Piece falls 5 rows = 10 points

Tip: Use Space for fast play!
ru.guide_how_to_play_tips:
━━━ IMPORTANT TIPS ━━━

• Ghost piece shows where the piece will land

• Use Hold system strategically

• Keep checking the next pieces

• Leave one edge open for Quadrix (4-line clear)
